mentions.name: birding.live
mentions.description: A free birding site that helps people look up bird sightings in their area, specifically rare ones. It connects to many open data sources (eBird, OSM, Nominatim, etc.) and plans to add a mailing list for alerts when birds are spotted in areas of interest.
mentions.audience: People looking up bird sightings in their area, especially those classed as rare
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building https://birding.live/ a birding site, that helps people look up bird sightings in their area, specifically those classed as rare. Connects to a whole lot of open data sources (eBird, OSM, Nominatim etc.)

Will remain free, planning to add some kindof mailing list for alerts when birds are spotted in areas of interest.
